gwbse.help: options excited state calculations via GWBSE

ranges.help: default: all levels in RPA, 1:2*HOMO in QP and all in BSE; other options: factor,explicit

rpamax.help: only needed, if ranges is factor or explicit, number of levels in rpa

qpmin.help: only needed, if ranges is factor or explicit, lowest MO to be used in GW

qpmax.help: only needed, if ranges is factor or explicit, highest MO to be used in GW

bsemin.help: only needed, if ranges is factor or explicit, lowest MO to be used in BSE

bsemax.help: only needed, if ranges is factor or explicit, highest MO to be used in BSE

qp_emax.help: cap on the GW window: highest QP level at most this many eV above the DFT LUMO (a degenerate set is kept whole); applied on top of ranges, 0 = off

qp_emin.help: cap on the GW window: lowest QP level at most this many eV below the DFT HOMO; 0 = off

bse_emax.help: cap on the BSE window: highest virtual level at most this many eV above the DFT LUMO; 0 = off

bse_emin.help: cap on the BSE window: lowest occupied level at most this many eV below the DFT HOMO; 0 = off

ignore_corelevels.help: exclude core MO level from calculation on RPA,GW or BSE level

auxbasisset.help: Auxiliary basis set for RI, only used if DFT has no auxiliary set

mode.help: use single short (G0W0) or self-consistent GW (evGW)

scissor_shift.help: preshift unoccupied MOs by a constant for GW calculation

eta.help: small parameter eta of the Green's function

alpha.help: parameter to smooth residue and integral calculation for the contour deformation technique

quadrature_scheme.help: If CDA is used for sigma integration this set the quadrature scheme to use

quadrature_order.help: Quadrature order if CDA is used for sigma integration

qp_grid_search_mode.help: grid-search backend for QP root detection

qp_root_finder.help: method to refine a sign-change interval of the QP equation to a root: brent (inverse quadratic interpolation with bisection safeguard, fewer Sigma evaluations) or bisection; both stop when the QP residual is below qp_sc_limit

qp_full_window_half_width.help: half-width of the full QP search window around the reference energy

qp_dense_spacing.help: spacing of the dense QP scan used for robust sign-change detection

qp_adaptive_shell_width.help: radial shell width of the adaptive QP scan

qp_adaptive_shell_count.help: number of adaptive shell layers per side; if > 0 it overrides qp_adaptive_shell_width

qp_grid_steps.help: DEPRECATED: legacy number of QP grid points; maps to qp_full_window_half_width and qp_adaptive_shell_width together with qp_grid_spacing

qp_grid_spacing.help: DEPRECATED: legacy QP grid spacing; maps to qp_dense_spacing and contributes to qp_full_window_half_width together with qp_grid_steps

qp_restrict_search.help: restrict occupied and virtual QP scans away from the zero-energy crossing region before retrying the full window

qp_root_continuity.help: evGW: from the second iteration on keep each QP level on the root closest to its previous solution instead of choosing the root with the largest weight again (stabilises levels with two roots of comparable weight)

core_exchange.help: with ignore_corelevels=RPA (frozen core): include the exchange with the core levels in Sigma_x, which Vxc also contains through the core density. Without it the occupied QP energies are shifted up by the missing core exchange (0.6 eV on average for a QM9 molecule)

qp_root_tracking.help: evGW: from the second iteration on search each QP level only near its root of the previous iteration (window of a few times its last change, 0.01 to 0.1 Ha) and keep the closest accepted root unless its weight drops below half; otherwise, and for levels without such a root, the full search is used. After convergence one QP solve with the full search checks the roots, so the result is a fixed point of the full search. If a level has several such fixed points (strong satellites), tracking may end on another one than iterating with the full search does

screening_update.help: evGW: when the screening W is rebuilt. every: in every iteration. adaptive: the energies in G are iterated with W fixed and W is rebuilt once their last change is below screening_update_ratio times their change since W was built (or after screening_update_max_inner iterations); converged when the energies change by less than gw_sc_limit and differ from those of the last W by less than gw_sc_limit, the same evGW solution

screening_update_ratio.help: adaptive screening_update: rebuild W once the last change of the energies is below this fraction of their change since W was built

screening_update_max_inner.help: adaptive screening_update: rebuild W at the latest after this many iterations with the same W

qp_zero_margin.help: margin below zero used as upper bound for occupied restricted scans

qp_virtual_min_energy.help: lower bound for virtual restricted scans

qp_sc_max_iter.help: maximum number of iterations for quasiparticle equation solution

sc_max_iter.help: Maximum number of iterations in eVGW

mixing_order.help: Mixing of QP energies in evGW - 0: plain, 1: linear, >1: Anderson

do_qsgw.help: Run Quasiparticle self-consistent GW after evGW or G0W0

qsgw_max_iterations.help: maximum number of iterations is QSGW

qsgw_sc_limit.help: QSGW convergence threshold on QP energies

qsgw_max_virt_correction.help: QSGW: pertGW energy threshold for inclusion of virtual states

qsgw_hartree_update.help: QSGW: update the Hartree potential with the QP density of the active occupied levels (false: keep J of the DFT density, the behaviour before)

qsgw_regularization.help: QSGW static self-energy: eta = symmetrised 1/2 Re[Sigma(e_p) + Sigma(e_q)] with the broadening eta; srg = similarity-renormalization-group form (Marie and Loos), Hermitian by construction, terms damped by 1 - exp(-s (D_p^2 + D_q^2)) with D the distance from their pole (exact and ppm Sigma)

qsgw_srg_s.help: QSGW with qsgw_regularization=srg: flow parameter s; s = 1/(2 eta^2) matches the eta form to first order (s = 200 for eta = 0.05 Ha); Marie and Loos recommend 500 to 1000

qsgw_hartree_screened.help: QSGW with environment screening: the Hartree update uses u = v + v_reac, so the dipoles induced in the environment follow the QP density (false: bare v, the environment keeps the response to the DFT density). No effect without environment screening or with qsgw_hartree_update=false

out_of_window_shift.help: Shift of the RPA energies of levels outside the GW window (evGW, QSGW): max - largest correction of the occupied/virtual window levels; nearest - correction of the window boundary level; linear - linear fit of the corrections near the boundary, extrapolated at most over the fitted energy span

out_of_window_fit_fraction.help: linear out_of_window_shift: fraction of the occupied/virtual window levels next to the boundary used in the fit (at least 2 levels)

rebuild_3c_freq.help: rebuild the 3c integrals from scratch every this many evGW iterations; 0 (default) never. The integrals are only rotated by orthogonal matrices between iterations, so a rebuild resets rounding at the 1e-12 Ha level

states.help: plot sigma(omega) for the following states, e.g 1 3 5

steps.help: points to plot, centred on the DFT energy of each state

filename.help: File with the sigma plot data

sigma_dump.help: Write self-energy and screening data (static parts, Sigma_c and derivatives and Z at the QP solution, pole spectrum and imaginary-axis Sigma_c per level, W_c in modes and in the plasmon-pole frame) to a separate HDF5 file; RKS, ppm and exact, G0W0 and evGW

levels_emax.help: pole spectra and imaginary-axis Sigma_c only for levels up to this energy above the DFT LUMO; 0 = all QP levels

imag_points.help: number of Gauss-Legendre points on the imaginary axis

imag_scale.help: scale s of the imaginary grid nu = s(1+x)/(1-x)

spectral_min.help: lower edge of the pole histogram (absolute energy)

spectral_max.help: upper edge of the pole histogram (absolute energy)

spectral_binwidth.help: bin width of the pole histogram

plot_steps.help: Sigma_c(omega) of all QP levels on this many points around their DFT energies (as sigma_plot, stored as float32); 0 = off

exctotal.help: maximum number of BSE states to calculate

dyn_screen_max_iter.help: maximum number of iterations for perturbative dynamical screening in BSE

dyn_screen_tol.help: convergence tolerance for perturbative dynamical screening in BSE

davidson.help: options for Davidson eigenvalue BSE solver

use_Hqp_offdiag.help: Using symmetrized off-diagonal elements of QP Hamiltonian in BSE

print_weight.help: print exciton WF composition weight larger than minimum

indices.help: indices of atoms in this fragment, e.g. 1 3 13:17
